ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is triangle CDE, CE is the bottom horizontal segment, point C is at the lower left, point E is at the lower right, and point D is at the upper left. In the figure, a purple dashed perpendicular line is drawn from D to line CE, with a right-angle mark, and the perpendicular length is labeled 24 in. Reasoning: The area of the triangle is 336 square inches, using CE as the base and 24 inches as the height. From the area formula A = (1/2) × base × height, we get 336 = (1/2) × CE × 24. Simplifying gives 336 = 12 × CE, so CE = 336 ÷ 12 = 28.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as triangle CDE with CE as the horizontal base. The dashed magenta perpendicular segment from D to line CE is labeled 24 in., so it is the height to base CE. method.method_draft: Read the image to see that the altitude from D to CE is 24 inches, perpendicular to the horizontal side CE. From the text, the area of triangle CDE is 336. Imagine duplicating triangle CDE with a congruent copy to form a parallelogram with the same base CE and height 24. The parallelogram area is twice the triangle area, so it is 672 square inches. Then parallelogram area = base × height gives 672 = CE × 24, so CE = 28.

推理：已知三角形 CDE 的面积是 336 平方英寸。按照方法，将三角形 CDE 复制一个全等三角形，可以拼成一个与它同底 CE、同高 24 的平行四边形。这个平行四边形面积是三角形面积的 2 倍，所以面积为 2 × 336 = 672 平方英寸。平行四边形面积 = 底 × 高，因此 672 = CE × 24。解得 CE = 672 ÷ 24 = 28。
